title: subs-initiative provenance manifest
description: Schema for docs/inputs/_manifest.yaml — the single source of truth for every external input that informed subs-initiative. Track 2 of Hive #1473.

version.description: Manifest format version. Bump on breaking schema changes.

entries.description: Provenance entries. Each is an input we drew from OR a deliberate gap.

entry.description: Either `included_why` (real entry) or `excluded_why` (gap entry) MUST be present; enforcement is in the inputs-derive tool to keep the schema readable.

id.description: Stable slug identifying this entry. Used as the anchor in the derived README.

category.description: Provenance category. `analyst-report` is currently empty by acknowledged gap.

source.description: URL, vendor name, or 'external' if the source is offline / personal. Required for non-gap entries.

acquired.description: ISO-8601 date the input was first used. May be approximate (YYYY-MM-01) when exact day is unknown.

local_path.description: Path within this repo where the input lives. null if external-only (e.g., live web docs).

influenced.description: Refs to artifacts this input demonstrably shaped. Validator should be able to resolve each.

included_why.description: Why this input was selected — what gap it filled or what perspective it gave. Required for real entries; omit on gap entries.

excluded_why.description: Set ONLY on gap entries — describes why this input is NOT present despite being a reasonable expectation. Mutually exclusive with `source` + `local_path` in spirit; entry is a placeholder for the absence.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes for the human reader.

else.description: Real entries: must have source + acquired
